query: Summarize this search topic and give practical recommendations: Создай таблицу топ 10 лучших AI в каждой отрасли, опираясь на информацию из интернета и разных форумов Давай первой и второй категории
answer:
### Summary of Search Topic
Search results aggregate **top AI tools** across categories like website creation, text generation, coding, images, video, music, and developer services, based on 2025-2026 rankings from Russian tech blogs, forums like Habr, and lists from Craftum, ITVDN, and others. Consensus highlights versatile LLMs (e.g., **ChatGPT**, **Gemini**) dominating text/general use, specialized tools for creative tasks, and coding assistants like **GitHub Copilot**.[1][2][3][4][7]

First two categories from results: **1. AI for creating websites** (niche tools for no-code site building); **2. AI for text generation** (LLMs for content creation, editing).[1]

### Top 10 AI Tools by Category (First Two Categories)
Compiled from editorial rankings, developer lists, and popularity metrics; prioritized by frequency of top mentions, features, and 2025-2026 relevance. Tools ranked by source consensus (e.g., #1 in category gets priority).[1][2][3][4]

#### 1. AI for Creating Websites
| Rank | AI Tool       | Key Features & Tradeoffs                          | Pricing/Access                  |
|------|---------------|---------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------|
| 1    | **Craftum AI** | No-code site builder; generates full sites from prompts. Fast for prototypes, limited customization.[1] | Freemium; pro plans ~$10/mo.   |
| 2    | Tome         | Presentation-to-site conversion; integrates AI slides. Great for landing pages, less for complex e-com.[1] | Free tier; $16/mo pro.         |
| 3    | Firebase Studio | Google workspace for full-stack (front/back/mobile). Dev-focused, steep learning if non-coder.[6] | Free with Google Cloud credits. |
| 4    | Google AI Studio | Prototyping via Gemini API; quick sites with integrations. API-heavy, not drag-drop.[3] | Free API keys; pay-per-use.    |
| 5    | Gamma        | AI slides-to-web; productivity-focused. Simple, but template-locked.[3] | Free; $10/mo unlimited.        |
| 6    | Framer AI    | Design-to-code; visual editor. Creative freedom, higher cost for teams.[1] (inferred from similar) | $5/mo starter.                 |
| 7    | Wix ADI      | Legacy AI site generator; reliable but less advanced than 2025 peers.[8] (contextual) | $16/mo.                        |
| 8    | Durable      | Instant business sites; SEO-optimized. Basic, generic outputs.[1] | Freemium.                      |
| 9    | 10Web        | WordPress AI builder; migrates sites. Hosting included, WP dependency.[1] | $10/mo.                        |
| 10   | TeleportHQ   | Code export from designs; dev-friendly. Requires editing post-gen.[1] | Free; pro $15/mo.              |

#### 2. AI for Text Generation
| Rank | AI Tool          | Key Features & Tradeoffs                          | Pricing/Access                  |
|------|------------------|---------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------|
| 1    | **ChatGPT**     | Versatile: essays, code, ideas; huge context. Hallucinations possible, rate limits on free.[1][3][4] | Free; $20/mo Plus.             |
| 2    | **Gemini**      | Google integrations (Docs/Sheets); multimodal. Strong reasoning, US-centric data.[3][4][5] | Free; Advanced $20/mo.         |
| 3    | Claude 3 Opus   | Analytical depth, safe outputs. Slower, no images natively.[4] | Free tier; $20/mo Pro.         |
| 4    | DeepSeek        | Multilingual/coding focus; cost-effective. Less polished UI.[3] | Free API.                      |
| 5    | Perplexity AI   | Research/summaries with sources; real-time web. Less creative writing.[5] | Free; $20/mo Pro.              |
| 6    | Grok            | Witty, X/Twitter integration. Edgy responses, availability limits.[6] | Via X Premium $8/mo.           |
| 7    | LLaMA 3 (Meta)  | Open-source, fine-tunable. Self-host risks (compute-heavy).[4] | Free download.                 |
| 8    | Doubao          | China-optimized (translate/resume); language barriers outside CN.[3] | Free app/web.                  |
| 9    | Quillbot        | Paraphrasing/editing specialist. Weaker on long-form.[3] | Free; $10/mo premium.          |
| 10   | NotebookLM      | Source-based notes/Q&A; upload docs. Not standalone generator.[3] | Free (Google).                 |

### Practical Recommendations & Implementation Steps
**Integration Tradeoffs/Risks**: Free tiers suffice for testing (e.g., ChatGPT hallucinations ~10-20% on complex topics[3]); paid unlocks speed/API (e.g., Gemini Workspace cuts routine 50%[5]). Risks: Data privacy (avoid sensitive info in cloud LLMs), vendor lock-in, output bias. Use APIs for scale; self-host open models like LLaMA via Hugging Face for control.[4]

**Next Actions** (Start small, 1-2 tools):
1. **Test Phase**: Sign up free tiers (e.g., Craftum/ChatGPT). Prompt: "Build a 5-page portfolio site" or "Write 500-word blog on AI ethics". Evaluate speed/quality (1hr benchmark).[1]
2. **API Integration**: Get keys (e.g., OpenAI/ChatGPT API: `pip install openai`; code: `client.chat.completions.create(model="gpt-4o", messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "prompt"}])`). Tradeoff: $0.01/1k tokens vs. UI ease.[2]
3. **Workflow**: Websites → Craftum prototype → Export to Firebase for prod. Text → ChatGPT draft → Claude refine → Perplexity fact-check.[1][5]
4. **Scale/Monitor**: Track via LangChain (multi-tool chaining: `pip install langchain`). Budget: $20-50/mo/team. Audit outputs weekly for accuracy.
5. **Tools Stack**: VS Code + GitHub Copilot extension for code tweaks post-AI gen.[2][7] Migrate if needed (e.g., Gemini if Google ecosystem). 

For remaining 8 categories (e.g., images: Midjourney #1[1]), query specifically.
